reports.name: Privileged Users
reports.description: Accounts holding Domain, Enterprise or Schema admin membership.

reports.name: Users with Admin Rights
reports.description: Users granted local or delegated administrative rights.

reports.name: Inactive Users with Access
reports.description: Accounts not signed in for 90+ days that still hold permissions.

reports.name: Group Membership
reports.description: Direct and nested membership for every security group.

reports.name: Password Never Expires
reports.description: Enabled accounts whose password is set to never expire.

reports.name: Permissions by User
reports.description: Effective permissions each user holds on files and folders.

reports.name: Permissions by Object
reports.description: Who can access a given folder, with the inheritance path.

reports.name: Excessive Permissions
reports.description: Permissions granted but never used in the last 180 days.

reports.name: Open Shares
reports.description: Shares accessible to Everyone, Authenticated Users or Domain Users.

reports.name: Broken Inheritance
reports.description: Folders where inheritance has been disabled.

reports.name: Permission Changes
reports.description: Permission modifications over the selected period.

reports.name: Site Permissions
reports.description: Permission levels for every site collection and sub-site.

reports.name: Externally Shared Items
reports.description: Files and folders shared with external users or anonymous links.

reports.name: Permissions by Group
reports.description: Site access granted through Microsoft 365 and security groups.

reports.name: Mailbox Permissions
reports.description: Full Access, Send As and Send on Behalf permissions.

reports.name: Mailbox Delegates
reports.description: Delegates configured on user and shared mailboxes.

reports.name: Shared File Permissions
reports.description: Permissions on files shared from personal OneDrive sites.

reports.name: Anonymous Links
reports.description: Active anyone-with-the-link sharing links.

reports.name: Server Roles
reports.description: Logins mapped to fixed and custom server roles.

reports.name: Database Permissions
reports.description: Database-level permissions for every principal.
